name: My WiSP
summary: Queensland fixed-wireless/hotspot ISP (mywisp.net.au, Canungra area, active 2005-07, ACN 110 247 946); network taken over by LiSP by Jul 2007 (LiSP later absorbed by Cirrus Communications).

events.details: Closure notice live by 3 Jul 2007: 'My WiSP is no longer operating... the equipment forming the My WiSP network is now being operated by LiSP Pty Ltd' (mywisp.net.au, Wayback 8 Aug 2007). LiSP was itself later absorbed by Cirrus Communications.
